scope: bounded deterministic action deliberation with capability, budget, risk, approval, kill-switch and memory; no LLM/tool I/O or external effects claim; actual monotonic timer release and asynchronous native RCL process with source-owned sampled-deadline publication, cancellation/exit observation and failure settlement; local soft realtime, no hard OS interrupt/timing guarantee or external effects

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual monotonic timers and asynchronous native process exit
RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery
authorityProfile: RCL conditional warrants own local sampled-deadline publication; Node transports clock observations, stops owned processes and waits for real exit; no hard realtime/OS interruption guarantee

trials.intent: Reject an action whose required capability does not equal the granted capability; all other eligibility checks still apply.
Reject actions whose cost exceeds the available budget; equal cost is permitted if all other checks pass.
An action requiring human approval must be rejected while approval is absent and may be considered when approval is present.
